arguments.text: Stage 3 work sample 0 complete. work.py evaluate filters evidence by matching claim, non-withdrawn status, policy-required condition values using canonical JSON, and verification when required; reports sorted missing conditions, applies eligible-record supersession, detects canonical-value conflict without source-count authority, maps Boolean false to unsupported, deep-copies agreed values, and does not modify inputs. report.json matches evaluation of current requests.json against evidence.json and policy.json. Local checks passed 8 behavioral cases plus report regeneration equivalence.

Unresolved limit: inputs and compared values are expected to be JSON-compatible. Canonical comparison uses json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False), so non-JSON values and NaN/Infinity raise rather than being assigned special semantics. Supersedes accepts a scalar or collection and operates by source ID among otherwise eligible records; duplicate source IDs are preserved in output because the task only requires sorted IDs, not deduplication.
